verses.1: Jehovah reigneth; let the peoples tremble: He sitteth above the cherubim; let the earth be moved.
verses.2: Jehovah is great in Zion; And he is high above all the peoples.
verses.3: Let them praise thy great and terrible name: Holy is he.
verses.4: The king ’s strength also loveth justice; Thou dost establish equity; Thou executest justice and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.5: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his footstool: Holy is he.
verses.6: Moses and Aaron among his priests, And Samuel among them that call upon his name; They called upon Jehovah, and he answered them.
verses.7: He spake unto them in the pillar of cloud: They kept his testimonies, And the statute that he gave them.
verses.8: Thou answeredst them, O Jehovah our God: Thou wast a God that forgavest them, Though thou tookest vengeance of their doings.
verses.9: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his holy hill; For Jehovah our God is holy.
